title: SaaS intake contract
text: Collect task, data sensitivity, hosting environment, budget, latency target, compliance constraints, expected volume, provider preference, and setup permission before recommending a pipeline.

title: Active pricing boundary
text: Live model and cloud prices must be fetched through volatile pricing tools and stored as run-scoped snapshots; stable personas and knowledge packs should contain pricing dimensions, not current prices.

title: Cheap balanced quality options
text: Return at least three architecture options: cheap rule-first plan, balanced retrieval-and-small-model plan, and quality-first plan with stronger models, evaluation, and human escalation.

title: Cost breakdown dimensions
text: Estimate model calls, input tokens, output tokens, cache hit rate, vector storage, object storage, queue invocations, observability, human review, and expected monthly volume separately.

title: Terraform and runtime outputs
text: A deployable blueprint should emit pipeline manifests, harness manifests, runtime config, Terraform skeletons, environment variable templates, MCP setup plan, benchmark components, and rollback notes.

title: MCP assisted setup approval
text: MCP assisted setup must list external actions, target accounts, permissions, estimated cost impact, and rollback path before creating repositories, secrets, cloud resources, vector indexes, or dashboards.

title: Browser research option
text: Use browser research when the task depends on rendered pages, dynamic provider documentation, screenshots, navigation state, or browser-only workflows; record domains visited, citations, screenshots, and cost or latency impact.

title: Embedding search option
text: Use embedding search to retrieve semantically similar catalog components, policies, examples, prior blueprints, and evaluation cases; report index snapshot, embedder, filters, and top-k assumptions.

title: Browser-local LLM option
text: Offer browser-local LLM or embedding execution when privacy, offline use, or hosted model cost matters, but gate the option on target-device feasibility, model download size, latency, and benchmark results.

title: Provider-neutral search router
text: Route search through a provider-neutral contract that can choose model-native web search, public search APIs, self-hosted search, private indexes, or custom cloud functions based on freshness, privacy, citation, locale, cost, and fallback requirements.

title: Search result normalization
text: Normalize all search providers into a common result shape with URL, title, snippet, fetched-content pointer, provider, retrieval timestamp, score, citation metadata, and audit fields before feeding RAG, ranking, or evaluation stages.

title: Custom cloud search function
text: Let users plug in serverless search functions for private or specialized corpora while keeping credentials as secret references and documenting endpoint, privacy boundary, timeout, retry, rate-limit, and cost behavior.

title: Containerized search runtime
text: Use a containerized search runtime when search requires long-running crawl jobs, rendered browser fleets, private corpus indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, OCR, high-memory processing, scheduled refresh, or strict network controls beyond a simple API or function call.

title: Container search cost dimensions
text: Estimate containerized search cost with image build time, CPU hours, memory GB-hours, GPU hours, index build minutes, storage, cache, queues, egress, observability, retry policy, and scheduled refresh frequency.
